title: Koi Mil Gaya
desc: Rohit, a mentally challenged youth, befriends an alien. When police discover the creature, they try to capture it, while Rohit bravely protects his extraordinary friend against all odds.

title: Krrish
desc: Krrish, gifted with superhuman powers, falls for Priya and travels to Singapore, where shocking truths about his father push him to embrace destiny and fight.

title: Seeta Aur Geeta
desc: Seeta runs away from her cruel aunt. Her look-alike Geeta takes over but gets arrested. Seeta is forced back into a life of suffering.

title: Attack
desc: After a terror attack leaves Arjun paralysed and grieving his lover, he joins a radical experiment when the attacker resurfaces, seeking revenge and a chance to fight back.

title: Haq
desc: In 1980s India, Shazia Bano fights for child support, but her husband's attempt to silence her through triple talaq sparks a nationwide debate on women's rights.

title: Kites
desc: Jay, a Las Vegas dance teacher, marries women for green cards. He weds Natasha for the same reason but unexpectedly falls in love when they reunite, complicating his plans.

title: Race 3
desc: While executing their biggest heist, a criminal family uncovers shocking truths that put their relationships and loyalties to the ultimate test.

title: Pure Bollywood
desc: Bollywood songs - catchy, emotional, and upbeat - dominate the charts. From heartbreak to celebration, these tracks capture every mood, making people dance, cry, and sing along everywhere.

title: Tumbbad
desc: A family builds a shrine for Hastar, a dangerous monster. When they try to take his cursed treasure, scary things start happening, and their lives turn into a nightmare.

title: Mr. India
desc: Arun shelters a group of orphans and is harassed by a gangster eyeing his house. After a child dies, he uses his father's invisibility watch to fight back.

title: Kalki 2898 AD
desc: In a ravaged world, a brave group races to protect a woman carrying Lord Vishnu's final avatar, Kalki, from Yaskin - the ruthless god-king bent on destroying her destiny.

title: Ek Aur Ek Gyarah
desc: Tara and Sitara, thieves, hide in Major Ram Singh's house. When Cobra kidnaps their mother, they must deceive Ram to save her and free Panther.

title: Wanted
desc: Fearless hitman Radhe operates without mercy for anyone who pays, yet he desperately seeks redemption after falling hard for Jhanvi, who despises his brutal, violent life of crime.

title: Singh Is King
desc: Happy, known for his wild antics, is sent to bring Lakhan to his ailing father. In Australia, events take a turn as Happy accidentally assumes Lakhan's role as the local underworld king.

title: Ram Teri Ganga Maili
desc: Ganga sets out for Calcutta with her son after her husband leaves them. Hoping for a better life, she is betrayed along the way and ends up trapped in a brothel.

title: Kya Kool Hain Hum 3
desc: Kanhaiya, an adult film actor in Thailand, falls for Shalu. To win over her traditional father, he fakes a respectable family with help from his quirky co-stars.
